name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-request-extension-guard
description: One DeepSeek request extension field failing must not kill the turn. The registry prepares every registered field under a single `Promise.all`, so one throwing provider — the package inventory collector hitting a profile manifest that declares a name but no version, a missing package, a dangling fallback link — fails preparation for the whole official request (`REQUEST_EXTENSION`), every turn, while the cause is swallowed (`LlmError` carries it as `cause`, which no surface renders). This plugin guards each registered provider's `prepare` (and every provider registered later, through the registry's own map): the failing field is skipped for that request, its exact cause is named in the host log with a self-rescue path, the surviving fields are delivered normally, and — opt-in — an absent `version` is added to the manifest that caused the walk to fail and the field is retried in the same request.
